scripts.dev: npm run check:protected-copy && cross-env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg vite
scripts.build: npm run check:protected-copy && npm run check:d1-boundary && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0040 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg vite build
scripts.test: npm run check:protected-copy && npm run check:d1-boundary && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:protected-copy && npm run check:d1-boundary && tsc --noEmit
scripts.db:migrate:local: cross-env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg wrangler d1 migrations apply board-game-rules-local --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: cross-env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg wrangler d1 migrations apply board-game-rules-prod --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:local: cross-env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg wrangler d1 execute board-game-rules-local --local --file=seed.sql
scripts.deploy:code: npm run build && cross-env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
